recipes.title: Blueberry Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Oats, yoghurt and blueberries ready straight from the fridge.

steps.text: Stir the oats, milk, yoghurt and maple syrup together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight. Stir again and top with blueberries before serving.

recipes.notes: Loosen with a splash of milk if the oats are too thick.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Spinach Toast
recipes.description: Buttery mushrooms and wilted spinach on toasted sourdough.

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms. Fry them in the butter over medium-high heat until golden.
Add the chopped garlic and spinach. Stir until the spinach wilts, then season.
Toast the bread and spoon the mushrooms and spinach over it.

recipes.notes: A squeeze of lemon brightens the mushrooms.

recipes.title: Lemon Chickpea Salad
recipes.description: A bright pantry salad with cucumber, parsley and a lemon dressing.

steps.text: Dice the cucumber, halve the tomatoes and chop the parsley.
Whisk the olive oil and lemon juice with salt and pepper. Toss with the chickpeas and vegetables.

recipes.notes: Add crumbled feta just before serving if you like.

recipes.title: Warm Beetroot and Lentil Salad
recipes.description: Earthy beetroot, green lentils and a sharp mustard dressing.

steps.text: Cut the beetroot into wedges and warm it with the lentils in a frying pan over medium heat.
Whisk the olive oil, vinegar and mustard. Toss with the warm lentils and beetroot, then fold in the rocket and walnuts.

recipes.notes: Swap walnuts for pumpkin seeds if you prefer.

recipes.title: Apple and Oat Crumble
recipes.description: Soft cinnamon apples under a crisp oat topping.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 190°C. Peel and slice the apples, then toss them with the cinnamon in a baking dish.
Rub the butter into the flour. Stir in the oats and sugar, then scatter the mixture over the apples.
Bake until the topping is golden and the apples are tender.

recipes.notes: Serve warm with plain yoghurt, custard or ice cream.

recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Pots
recipes.description: Small chilled chocolate desserts with a pinch of sea salt.

steps.text: Chop the chocolate and place it in a heatproof bowl. Warm the cream and milk until steaming.
Pour the hot cream mixture over the chocolate. Let it sit, then stir until smooth.
Divide between small ramekins. Chill for at least two hours and finish with sea salt.

recipes.notes: This recipe makes four small servings.
